roles.name: Agent_1
roles.title: captain and round coordinator
duties: Nominate the active speaker and track challenges, refusals, and the permitted time-out.
Submit the team's written proxy artifact after internal verification.

roles.name: Agent_2
roles.title: scientific lead
duties: Develop the chemical argument and verify calculations and experimental claims.
Prepare a defensible explanation for jury questioning.

roles.name: Agent_3
roles.title: evidence and integrity reviewer
duties: Check that every claim is supported by the supplied evidence.
Challenge fabricated measurements, unsupported citations, and weak causal claims.

roles.name: Agent_4
roles.title: opposition-preparation strategist
duties: Anticipate objections from an external Opponent without impersonating that team.
Prepare concise responses for the active speaker and jury questions.
